results.notes: Native CUA shows the login page after logout. No fixture deletion or credential changes.

Landscape playback, next and close passed. Logout completed after returning to portrait. Landscape account-dialog scrolling did not produce an observable scroll using the available CUA gestures; it remains inconclusive, not accepted. No document edits or deletion. Dedicated simulator shut down.

lastRun.notes: Focused portrait and landscape presentation acceptance only. Physical devices, keyboard navigation, full editor/file/offline regression and store distribution are not established. Landscape account-dialog scrolling remains inconclusive. Existing local server export behavior is not covered. Follow-up control drag activated a workspace card rather than scrolling; input reliability prevents a confirmed defect conclusion. Portrait logout was visibly verified again and the dedicated simulator shut down. Evidence: releases/mobile/ios-0.1.3-scroll-control-activation.png and releases/mobile/ios-0.1.3-scroll-followup-logout.png. No application changes or document edits.
exclusions: Keyboard navigation and landscape account-dialog scrolling
